definitions.explanation: Turning against a ruler, a government, an authority or one's own side. Also used for rebellion against parents or social rules.

examples.japanese: {反逆|はんぎゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{企|くわだ}てる→企てる：15422_kuwadateru⟧。

⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧や⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反逆|はんぎゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧だった。
examples.english: When I was young, rebellion against my parents and society was what got me into music.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反逆|はんぎゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{企|くわだ}てる→企てる：15422_kuwadateru⟧: to plot rebellion
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{反逆|はんぎゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rebel against ~
- {反逆者|はんぎゃくしゃ}: a rebel, a traitor
- {国家反逆罪|こっかはんぎゃくざい}: high treason

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反抗|はんこう}→反抗：03568_hankou⟧: defiance, resistance — the everyday word, e.g. a teenager's ⟦{反抗期|はんこうき}→反抗期：15877_hankouki⟧
- ⟦{謀反|むほん}→謀反：14455_muhon⟧: rebellion against one's lord — historical
- ⟦{裏切|うらぎ}り→裏切り：17967_uragiri⟧: betrayal — personal rather than political
